title_zh: 为敏感段落保留拒读选择

scenario.label_zh: 为涉及性暴力议题的剧本段落设置自愿朗读选择
scenario.goal_zh: 说明剧本涉及的敏感议题并约定提前提示和自愿替代段落

context_zh: 成年业余演员参加虚构剧本朗读筹备。导演 Peta 与组织者 Luis 只讨论非露骨的内容提示和参与选择，不叙述性暴力细节。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Peta
sentences.text: The play refers to rape, although there is no depiction of an assault.

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: Then we should tell the readers before they choose a part.

sentences.speaker: Peta
sentences.text: I also want any refusal to read those passages to be respected, without asking for a personal explanation.

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: Agreed. We'll offer an alternative passage, regardless of someone's experience in the group.

sentences.speaker: Peta
sentences.text: I'll put both the content note and that choice in the invitation.

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: And I'll make sure the session plan includes time for people to choose privately.

targets.sense_zh: 不受某因素影响；无论如何
